prompt:
A real photograph, vertical frame, taken looking down from a first-floor
balcony on the near side of the narrow Madrid street of the third reference
picture, in the soft morning sun. Along the bottom edge of the picture runs
the black wrought-iron railing of that balcony, with a pot of red geraniums in
its lower left corner.

Below, across the street, the small white car is parked at the far kerb, its
front pointing to the left of the picture and its tailgate
open on the right, the boot full of brown cardboard boxes. On the pavement just
to the right of the open tailgate stands the young man of the first reference
picture, in his white T-shirt and jeans, and further to the right of the
picture, facing him, the woman of the second reference picture, in her navy
coat. Her red and dark-green tartan shopping trolley stands on the pavement
between the two of them, at her side. They face each other, laughing
together, her hand on his forearm. Behind them, the ochre facade with its green double door. The
shadows fall towards the left of the picture.
